description: A bearded man in a tall ornate cylindrical headdress and a red and gold embroidered robe stands in the foreground holding a sword hilt, looking off to the side. Behind him, ranks of soldiers in scale armour carry round shields and spears, mounted archers ride on the left, and a scribe with a clipboard-like tablet and stylus stands at the right. Tents, smoke and a dusty plain stretch into the distance under a stormy sky. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
